_comment: Reference copy of the parameters aircraft_factory.cpp currently hardcodes for spawnGenericNarrowbody(). This file is NOT parsed at runtime yet in the Alpha (there is no JSON loader wired in) — it exists so the shape of a future per-aircraft data file is pinned down and reviewable, and so wiring up a real loader later is a mechanical change (read this shape, populate the same AircraftComponent fields) rather than a design decision. These are generic narrowbody-class magnitudes, not a certified aircraft's real aerodynamic database.
_note_on_real_A320_data: A320-family.zip (provided alongside this build) is the FlightGear GPL 'A320-family' add-on: its A32x.xml files carry FDM tables in FlightGear's own JSDM/YASim schema, and its .ac files are AC3D meshes for FlightGear's renderer. Neither maps directly onto this engine's AeroCoefficients/mesh-binding model, so its numbers were not extracted into this file. Porting real A320 aerodynamic coefficients here (with correct attribution/licensing review, since that project is GPL) is future work, not done in this Alpha.
